applies_why: The judge text grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the virgin/young-woman wording and the prophetic application of Isaiah 7:14, so it treats a verse with two senses as open.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: Phrase interpreted: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. I weighed reading one that two senses make the verse not open and both senses stand against reading two that two senses leave it underdetermined.
why: The judge marks the verse UNDERDETERMINED because its two aspects were answered separately, which K-S2 forbids by making such a verse not open with both senses standing.
